graph.title: LEGO 9471 Uruk-hai Army
notes: The two groups are intentional. The booklet builds two separate models from two numbered bags (page 2-3): bag 1 is the Uruk-hai catapult (steps 1-16, pieces b1-b96) and bag 2 is the gate tower with the Rohan horseman and archer (steps 1-35, pieces b97-b229). No step in the manual joins a catapult piece to a tower piece. Page 72 only shows the set combined with set 9474 as a display idea, so I did not invent any catapult-to-tower join.

Minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, helmets, capes, armour) are not in the parts list, so they are not nodes. Their held items are nodes: halberds b1/b2, swords b3/b4, shields b5/b6, Rohan spear b97, round shield b98 and bow b99. To keep these from floating, each is tied to its model by a 'contact' edge standing in for the minifigure that holds it. The Uruk-hai weapons rest on the catapult frame beams b9/b10. The spear and shield rest on the horse saddle b103. The bow rests on the tower roof b184 where the archer stands. The horse b100 rests beside the tower base b105. These contact edges are interpretive.

Most stud/anti-stud joins have null ports. Pieces that sit on an upper or lower layer are joined to one piece they rest on. The image-only steps do not show every stud pair, so exact stacking in the tower (steps 3-31) and some catapult positions are approximate.

Corner-style bricks in tower steps 4, 5, 12, 14, 24 and 28 are 12 pieces. The parts list gives 10 wedged facet bricks (87620) and 2 corner bricks (2357). I assumed the two 2357 bricks are the pair in step 12 and the rest are 87620.
Wheels: each tan axle pin (3749) sits in a beam pin hole. Its axle end goes through the 4x4 round wheel (60474) into a 2x2 axle-hole hub (4032a).
Catapult step 9 wood-grain tiles are shown as joined to the beams. The picture does not make clear which stud or pin holds them.

Catapult bolts (30192 hook, 32123b bush, 59900 cone, 61184 pin with bar): the rod end passes through the wing pin hole and into a pin hole of the 1x2 Technic brick b76. The hook, bush and cone sit on the bar. Exact bar/hole ports are interpreted from page 24.
Hinge tiles 44300 sit on the 1x1 clip plates 61252 and hinge with the 44302a hinge plates that carry the arm blades.
The 3 round bricks in tower step 33 and the torch/flag mounts in step 34 sit on roof plates and jumper studs. The positions are approximate.
The stairs b174 rest on the reddish bridge plate b169 with a plate b175 on top. The top attachment to the wall is not modelled.
